_note: Candidate models per kind, for the installer's VRAM-sized picker. Grounded in real footprints: approx_gb for anything currently installed is MEASURED from `ollama list` on the reference box; entries marked "estimated": true are not installed here and their sizes are floors to refine once pulled. min_vram_gb is a curated floor for running the model as the SOLE resident (weights + KV cache + overhead), which is the only case that matters given the broker's one-heavy-model gate. The `default: true` entry per kind mirrors services/broker/roles.json, so the picker's recommendation matches what the platform ships with when the card is big enough.

chat.note: CPU-viable, weakest. The floor for an 8 GB card.
Fast and capable enough for most rails.
The default chat model across the platform.
Strongest reasoning, largest footprint. Used for @reasoning / @code / fraud.

vision.note: Small multimodal, basic image reading. The only vision option that fits a small card.
gemma4 is multimodal; the 12b reads images acceptably at far less VRAM than the 26b.
The default vision model; also serves the writer roles, so it loads once.

embed.note: The default embedder; ships regardless of card size.

image.note: Lighter image path, 4-step. Needs the GPU media venv (torch + diffusers).
Default icon/image backend. Needs the GPU media venv; not an Ollama tag.
